title: [IMP-35] Show current PPAP and review workload
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-35

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-35

Title
Show current PPAP and review workload

Category
Operational reports

Objective
Give SIA users a reliable live view of open PPAP, review and element work.

Detailed scope
Configure current drawing-review, PPAP and element worklists, overdue/age filters and authorized linked-result readiness using native workflow instances. Update only target branches of existing PPAP inventories and keep Approved separate from Cancelled.

Deliverable
Source-review and PPAP/element operational queues without duplicate counts.

Work needed first
IMP-03 — Set up PPAP scope and the integrated part warrant
IMP-04 — Set up PPAP issue and approval facts
IMP-05 — Set up element work and checklist answers
IMP-11 — Set up model schedules and physical build events
IMP-12 — Set up engineering source and drawing-review forms
IMP-17 — Resolve SIA and supplier responsibility and eligibility
IMP-24 — Connect required inspection results to their evidence
IMP-32 — Restrict PPAP records, decisions and files

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-03 provides the PPAP facility/drawing/part/warrant fields and target due/display settings.
• IMP-04 provides the issue, review, replacement, cancellation and frozen approval/output fields.
• IMP-05 provides the element/working-answer fields and typed preparation controls.
• IMP-11 provides the model/date/build-event fields and PPAP schedule links.
• IMP-12 provides the engineering-release/source-part/review fields and preparation forms.
• IMP-17 provides the exact-entity role/capability checks and eligible assignment operation.
• IMP-24 provides the result/version link fields and exact acceptance/artifact operation.
• IMP-32 provides the scoped record/field/file and visibility-handover rules.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: report layouts/filters can proceed; executable native queries and date boundaries wait for report bindings and business timezone.

Recommended implementer role
Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment connects defined records and actions through supplied native methods. A Consultant should configure the cross-record checks and failure messages; it does not assign the external application build.

Changes to the existing setup
APQP_PPAP_Inventory_Open (602f2dea-d5e4-4980-97a9-7418f8203540)
The package displays legacy open PPAP work. Add a target branch over target native workflow stages with source, facility, drawing/revision, model, internal engineer, due date/age and required-element readiness; keep historical rendering separate.

APQP_PPAP_Inventory_Closed (2d0d1ac4-ae26-46f1-826d-c07b4422f7f8)
The package displays legacy closed PPAP work. Add a target branch that explicitly separates Approved and Cancelled with actual actor/date and authorized certificate/history navigation; never include cancellation in successful completion totals.

Build instructions
1. Create a drawing-review queue with Engineering Release/drawing/revision, Change Type, exact routing entity/current engineer, Due Date and age/overdue; include only records within reader permissions.
2. Configure a PPAP queue with one row per target PPAP native workflow instance, filtering model/type/source, facility/supplier, drawing/revision, SIA PPAP Engineer/role, stage, due date and age. Add required-element approved/open/review counts and replacement-hold status without using legacy ProjectTasks counters.
3. Configure an element queue with one row per required native element instance, exposing Work Pattern, assigned role/team/person, PPAP/model/source, Effective Due Date, current Engineer Review Due Date and open/review age. Keep group responsibility distinct from actual action actor and current supplier deadline distinct from engineer review target.
4. Join parts/files/depots/members through grouped related data or existence checks so they cannot multiply workflow counts. Show only explicit required inspection acceptance readiness; unrelated pilot failures are not a new blocking column. Apply source permissions to every drilldown/export.
5. Use Drawing Review.Due Date for initial review; for PPAP use Management Review Due Date in Management Review and PPAP Due Date otherwise. For elements use Engineer Review Due Date in Engineer Review and Effective Due Date otherwise. Due today is not overdue: overdue begins only when current business date exceeds due date, and overdue days is the nonnegative calendar-date difference. Stage age uses the latest entry into the current native stage. Bind a materially-overdue report threshold only to its supplied approved report value; do not silently equate it with escalation settings.

How to check the result
• Adding another file, part or group member does not double the PPAP/element count.
• Overdue review work is distinguishable from overdue supplier submission work; Cancelled is never counted as Approved.

Information needed for this task
IN-12: Supply native workflow/report/history source identifiers, supported query/filter methods and limits, plus the approved materially-overdue report threshold. Known columns and due/overdue rules can proceed; do not invent that threshold.
IN-10: Supply business timezone for due-date/age boundaries.

Supplied input context
• IN-12 — Report source fields and reporting periods: The technical team must supply native workflow/history/audit/report field identifiers and supported report/query methods. SIA must agree the materially-overdue report threshold and reporting-period/cohort boundaries for historical supplier timeliness. Any later scorecard attribution/query connection is supplied by the scorecard owner; scoring configuration and published-scorecard updates are not PPAP tasks.
• IN-10 — Business timezone and native notice scheduling: SIA must supply its business timezone. The technical team must supply the native reminder/delivery settings for the proposed daily 08:00 scan, repeat prevention, retry and access checks at delivery. Calendar-day values are known; the timezone and native connection cannot be inferred from the workstation.

Specification references
• [Target PPAP technical specification](ppap-target-technical-specification.md)
• [Canonical target field contract](ppap-target-field-contract.md)

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
